textbookBox.concept: People keep money in bank accounts, which are demand deposits. Cheques allow payments without cash.

beats.en: People keep money in bank accounts, which are demand deposits. Cheques allow payments without cash.
beats.speakEn: People keep money in bank accounts, which are demand deposits. Cheques allow payments without cash.

beats.en: Banks keep a part of deposits as cash and lend the rest. They earn interest on loans, which is more than they pay on deposits.
beats.speakEn: Banks keep a part of deposits as cash and lend the rest. They earn interest on loans, which is more than they pay on deposits.
